name: MiMigatari
source: The two Bakayaro.de mascots, Midori and Mikan, have made it — their very first game, in the form of a visual novel, has been released. This marks the beginning of a new chapter for them. However, this first episode is not just a visual novel, but also a prize giveaway for you!
